items.title: Mary Joy Ethiopia Inaugurates the Hawassa Kidney Dialysis Center
items.excerpt: Mary Joy Ethiopia is proud to announce the official inauguration of its Hawassa Kidney Dialysis Center, a landmark initiative that brings life-saving medical services to the Southern region of Ethiopia. The ceremony took place in Hawassa, with the presence of senior government officials, healthcare leaders, and Mary Joy's board members.
